empresaESistema.thisAssetSSetupsAre: This asset's setups are used in these build-ups, which lose the machine cost if you simplify the record:

empresaESistema.whenOnTheAssetGets2: When on, the asset gets a unit, planned monthly volume and production setups. This is for machines that produce.

empresaESistema.aGroupWithNoAssets: A group with no assets generates no cost: build-ups that depend on it end up without the machine cost.

producao.theCompanyWorkingDaysAnd: The company working days and hours, the break and the holidays. Each new board starts with these hours and can be edited. Delivery-at-risk alerts only count this time. On holidays, the schedule still lets you book, but the day turns red.
producao.onePerDepartmentThatProduces: One per department that produces. The color is the department's, set in the department records.
producao.eachDepartmentChoosesHowIt: Each department chooses how it captures time: the individual clock (Play & Stop) or dragging the team member onto the task (collective).
producao.theTypeIsChosenIn: The type is chosen in the build-up step of the product or process. It tells the task where it goes in production.
producao.whoSeesWhatIsAn: Who sees what is an access setting: the profile says whether the person sees everything, and access to each board says what the operator sees there.
producao.productivityPerPersonOnlyShows: Productivity per person only shows for whoever edits production (manager). Access per board is given in "Who has access", in the Boards tab.
producao.theVehiclesThatInstallationAnd: The vehicles that installation and delivery take up on the schedule. A busy vehicle does not show as free for another trip at the same time.
producao.theBoardIsTheDepartment: The board is the department in production: its queue, how time is captured and the color, which comes from the department records.
producao.theTimeBetweenOneTask: The time between one task and the next on the same equipment: material change, cleaning.
producao.itIsNotTheTask: It is not the task setup. If you already count the change in the setup, leave zero.
producao.startingPausingAndTimingTasks: Starting, pausing and timing tasks belong to the Elite plan.
producao.theWaitAfterCompletionBefore: The wait after completion before the next stage starts, like letting a print dry before finishing.
producao.countsTowardTheDeliveryForecast: Counts toward the delivery forecast. With no wait, leave zero.
producao.thisDepartmentSHoursThe: This department's hours. The queue forecasts each job's start and end from them, and anything past closing time shows in red.
producao.aNewBoardComesWith: A new board comes with the company working hours, which you can edit here. Left blank, the company hours apply. The break (lunch) is optional.
producao.theMachineKeepsRunningDuring: The machine keeps running during the break
producao.theOperatorSeesTheDepartment: The operator sees the department's tasks or only those assigned to them; the production manager sees everything, in any board.
producao.theStepsThatGoThrough: The steps that go through it move to another board. No task is left without a place.
producao.thisIsTheTaskType: This is the "task type" of the build-up steps: it sets which production boards the task goes through and when it is released. The color is the department color of each step.
producao.whenOnTheClockMeasures: When on, the clock measures the time logged on tasks of this type. Productivity compares that time with what was sold.
producao.theTaskGoesThroughThe: The task goes through the steps in this order. Each step can be on a different board: printing on Printing, trimming on Production.
producao.installationAndDeliveryTakeUp: Installation and delivery take up the vehicle on the schedule: time, km and who goes out.
producao.soYouDoNotNeed: So you do not need to buy more storage: deletes the oldest files until the chosen percentage of used space is freed.
producao.onlyFilesAddedToDelivered: Only files added to delivered work orders, with the Closed status, are included (artwork, edited versions, proofs, PDFs and projects). Nothing from the registers and nothing from work orders not yet delivered.
producao.thereAreNoFilesFrom: There are no files from delivered work orders to delete.
producao.deletingCannotBeUndoneIn: Deleting cannot be undone. In the task, the file shows as "removed in cleanup", with the date.
producao.overnightWhenUsedSpaceGoes: Overnight, when used space goes over the limit, deletes the oldest files until the percentage is freed. Off by default.
producao.freesWithTheFilesOf: Frees {valor} with the files of {projects} delivered work orders, uploaded from {null} to {null2}. This cannot be undone.
producao.overnightWhenTheSpaceUsed: Overnight, when the space used goes over {threshold}%, the oldest files from delivered work orders will be deleted until {percent}% of the space used is freed, without asking again. This cannot be undone.
producao.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to configure production.

produtos.noProcessRegisteredForThis: No process registered for this department.

produtos.xYAndWeightIn: X, Y and weight in the formula
produtos.xAndYAreThe: X and Y are the sides of the profile chosen on the line, in meters. Weight is per material sales unit.
produtos.ifTheSalespersonChangesThe: If the salesperson changes the material in the quote, the formula uses the new material's dimensions.
produtos.withThisProductSStandard: With this product's standard size, the formula gives {valor}.
produtos.theProductCanGoWith: The product can go with or without this item: in the quote, the salesperson checks whether the job includes it.
produtos.withoutThisOptionTheItem: Without this option, the item is always included.
produtos.yesTheItemIsAlready: Yes: the item is already in the quote, in the cost and in the suggested price shown here.
produtos.noItStaysOutAnd: No: it stays out and only goes in if the salesperson ticks it.
produtos.whatTheDepartmentUsesIn: What the {valor} department uses in this step, and how the quantity is calculated from the size sold.
produtos.chooseTheResourceTheName: Choose the resource: the name comes from it
produtos.oneResourceAlwaysTheSame: One resource, always the same: the printer, the banner vinyl, the department hour.
produtos.noResourceMatchesThisSearch: No resource matches this search. Clear the search or the unit filter.
produtos.noResourceOfThisType: No resource of this type in the Cost base.
produtos.theOptionsOfAChoice: The options of a choice must have the same unit.
produtos.theNumberOfPeopleMultiplies: The number of people multiplies the time: two people for 30 minutes is 60 minutes of labor.
produtos.appliesOnlyToTheVariant: Applies only to the {variationName} variant. The rest follows the base.
produtos.theMinimumTimeKeepsA: The minimum time keeps a small piece from getting an unrealistic time: the setup that exists even for one unit. People multiply the time.
produtos.wasteIsAddedToUsage: Waste is added to usage (the cutting offcut). The minimum keeps a small piece from getting an unrealistic cost.
produtos.whenOnItChargesThe: When on, it charges the whole sheet or board.
produtos.whenOffItChargesOnly: When off, it charges only the part used, when the leftover goes back to stock. The default comes from the material record.
produtos.ifBlankTheLineValue: · if blank, the line value applies
produtos.inTheSameOptionGroup: In the same option group, each material can have its own consumption, waste and minimum. Example: ACM uses 1.0 and PVC 1.2, with a 0.5 minimum.
produtos.blankMeansTheLineS: Blank means the line's value applies.
produtos.howThisStepAppearsTo: How this step appears to the salesperson in the quote.
produtos.theNameChangesOnlyIn: The name changes only in this product. The process keeps its own name.
produtos.thereIsNoTaskType: There is no task type "{taskType}" in Settings › Production: the task goes to the default type, Production.
produtos.changingTheProcessChangesEvery: Changing the process changes every product that uses it — that is done in
produtos.useOwnRulesInThis: Use own rules in this product
produtos.whenOnTheRulesApply: When on, the rules apply only to this step of this product.
produtos.whenOffTheStepFollows: When off, the step follows the process rules.
produtos.ofTheseOnlyTheChosen: Of these, only the chosen one counts toward the cost.
produtos.theSalespersonEntersInThe: The salesperson enters in the quote how much was used of each.
produtos.thisResourceIsAlreadyOn: This resource is already on the line: the name tells the setups apart.
produtos.withANameTheSame: With a name, the same resource can be added again with a different usage.
produtos.anotherProductWithABuild: Another product with a build-up, used inside this one: the iron frame of the sign, the channel letters of the storefront sign.

produtos.itIsAlreadyTheSale: It is already the sale price.
produtos.mToChangeItSimulate: m. To change it, simulate another size and use "Save as standard".

produtos.valuesAppearOnceThereIs: Values appear once there is a step with a cost.
produtos.simulatingMTheStandardIs: Simulating {quantity} × {width} × {height} m. The standard is {quantity2} × {width2} × {height2} m.

produtos.theProductCostIsThe: The product cost is the sum of the steps, at the size sold.
produtos.whatYouAddHereExists: What you add here exists only in {name}. The base steps still apply.
produtos.theDrawingOfTheSteps: The drawing of the steps in production order. Each box is a department's step.
produtos.theAddsTheNextStep: The "+" adds the next step; the box menu turns the step on, off or swaps it. You can split the flow into paths that run at the same time.
produtos.eachResourceOnceSummedAcross: Each resource once, summed across all steps, at the simulated size. It is the list of what the product uses.
produtos.upToPeopleAtThe: up to {people} people at the same time
produtos.technicalDescriptionNotSavedYet: Technical description not saved yet. Everything else is already saved.
produtos.aPathThatStartsOn: A path that starts on its own — the frame that later meets the banner vinyl at installation. Connect it to a step from the box menu.
produtos.theBoxStaysInThe: The box stays in the same place in the flow, with the same connections. What changes is the setup: resources, time and rules become those of the process.
produtos.thisVariantSBuildUp: This variant's build-up is removed. The other variants and the standard build-up do not change.
produtos.theNameAppearsOnThe: The name appears on the tab and in the salesperson's choice.
produtos.theVariantStartsAsA: The variant starts as a copy of what is set up in {valor}: steps, resources, quote fields, formulas, ranges and selling value. Once created, the two are independent: changing one does not change the other.
produtos.searchProcessByNameOr: Search process by name or department
produtos.theStepBelongsToThis: The step belongs to this product. Once created, add the resources and the time the department uses on it.
produtos.anotherProductWithABuild2: Another product with a build-up, used inside this one: the iron frame of the sign, the ACM panel of the storefront sign. The box opens and shows what the part has inside.
produtos.theStepNowAlsoDepends: The step now also depends on the one you choose: in production, it is only released when both are done.
produtos.thereIsNoOtherStep: There is no other step to connect.
produtos.upTo100OneValue: Up to 100 one value, from 101 to 500 another. The range applies to the sale total: 150 units all go out at the second range's value. Without a table, the product's selling value applies.
produtos.saveToSeeTheCost: Save to see the cost and margin of each range.
produtos.variantIsBackToThe: Variant is back to the product table
produtos.noFieldsYetCreateA: No fields yet. Create a field here (number of letters, perimeter, distance between grommets) and the calculation types that read that value will show up on the lines.
produtos.byDefaultTheFieldTakes: By default the field takes only whole numbers, such as the number of letters or grommets: the quote rejects decimals.
produtos.turnOnAcceptsFractionWhen: Turn on "Accepts fraction" when the field is a measurement, such as meters.
produtos.inTheQuoteTheSalesperson: In the quote, the salesperson sees only these fields. The build-up, steps and supplies stay off their screen.
produtos.noFormulasYetOneCan: No formulas yet. One can also be created from inside the line, in the last option of the calculation type.
produtos.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view build-ups.
produtos.duplicatedEditTheCopyFrom: {name} duplicated. Edit the copy from here.
produtos.selectACsvFileTo: Select a CSV file to import products in bulk
produtos.overwriteProductsWithTheSame: Overwrite products with the same code (Update existing)
produtos.confirmationToDeactivateOrActivate: Confirmation to deactivate or activate the product.
produtos.theProductBecomesAvailableAgain: The product becomes available again for quotes and sales, and the steps where it is a part lose the inactive product mark.
produtos.lookingForWhereItIs: Looking for where it is used…
produtos.itIsNotPartOf: It is not part of any other product. It becomes unavailable for new quotes and sales.
produtos.itIsPartOfThe: It is part of {valor} {valor2}. The step stays there, marked "inactive product"; it just stops being offered in new quotes and as a new part.
produtos.replaceOrRemoveTheItem: : replace or remove the item before approving.
produtos.theGroupIsCreatedIn: The group is created in the chosen sector and is selected on the product.
produtos.enterAtLeastOneSupplier: Enter at least one supplier for the outsourced product
produtos.theApiDoesNotAccept: The API does not accept yet: {valor}. The product was saved without those fields.
produtos.productSavedButThereWas: Product saved, but there was an error saving the tax data{valor}
produtos.onANewProductThe: On a new product, the code is created from the name: the first letters of the main words, 5 letters long. If it already exists, a number is added at the end.
produtos.afterSavingTheCodeCan: After saving, the code can be edited. It is unique in the company and helps find the product quickly in search and in the spreadsheet.
produtos.writeTheTechnicalDescriptionOf: Write the technical description of this product.
produtos.saveTheProductToSet: Save the product to set up printing: bleed and make-ready sheets.
produtos.theSmallestSizeTheCompany: The smallest size the company charges for this product, even if the order is smaller.
produtos.theDepartmentsTheProductGoes: The departments the product goes through. The Delivery schedule uses this list to show which department each order is in.
produtos.onProTheDeliverySchedule: On PRO, the Delivery schedule and the department screens follow the stages of the build-up above. This list applies while the product has no released build-up.
produtos.theStepFlowAppearsAfter: The step flow appears after saving
produtos.fillInTheProductTab: Fill in the Product tab and save. The product reopens on this tab so you can set up the steps, with the processes, materials and times of each.
produtos.belowItTheItemIs: Below it, the item is charged by the minimum quantity: at R$ 100.00 per m² with a 0.5 m² minimum, the item costs R$ 50.00 even with 0.2 m² of artwork. The typed measure stays, and the total area shows in red pointing to the minimum.
produtos.belowItTheItemIs2: Below it, the item is charged by the minimum quantity: at R$ 20.00 per meter with a 0.5 m minimum, the item costs R$ 10.00 even at 0.3 m. The typed measure stays, and the total points to the minimum in red.
produtos.belowItTheItemIs3: Below it, the item is charged by the minimum quantity: at R$ 40.00 per kilo with a 0.5 kg minimum, the item costs R$ 20.00 even at 0.2 kg. The typed weight stays, and the total points to the minimum in red.
produtos.belowItTheItemIs4: Below it, the item is charged by the minimum quantity: at R$ 30.00 per liter with a 0.5 l minimum, the item costs R$ 15.00 even at 0.2 l. The typed quantity stays, and the total points to the minimum in red.
produtos.belowItTheItemIs5: Below it, the item is charged by the minimum quantity: at R$ 5.00 per kilometer with a 10 km minimum, the item costs R$ 50.00 even at 4 km. The typed distance stays, and the total points to the minimum in red.
produtos.belowItTheItemIs6: Below it, the item is charged by the minimum quantity: at R$ 80.00 per hour with a 1 h minimum, the item costs R$ 80.00 even at 30 minutes. The typed time stays, and the total points to the minimum in red.
produtos.theItemStartsWithThat: The item starts with that quantity in the quote and, below it, is charged by the minimum quantity: at R$ 1.00 per unit with a 100 un minimum, the item costs R$ 100.00 even when 50 are ordered. The typed quantity stays, and the total points to the minimum in red.
produtos.variantsMinimumQuantityQuantityPricing: Variants, minimum quantity, quantity pricing and sheet printing.
produtos.variantsMinimumQuantityAndQuantity: Variants, minimum quantity and quantity pricing.
produtos.sheetPrintingBleedAndMake: Sheet printing: bleed and make-ready sheets.
produtos.itIsTheProductThe: It is the product the company buys ready-made from a supplier and resells.
produtos.whenTheSaleIsApproved: When the sale is approved, the system creates the bill to the supplier with the cost entered here. The customer does not see that the product is outsourced.
produtos.theSalePriceCanCome: The sale price can come from the cost plus the company's standard markup (Settings › Sales).
produtos.salePriceSuggestedByThe: Sale price suggested by the markup of
produtos.ofStagesUsedByThis: {active} of {valor} stages used by this product
produtos.theDepartmentsTheProductGoes2: The departments the product goes through in production
produtos.priceRangesForThisVariant: Price ranges for this variant only. With no ranges, the variant price applies.
produtos.aPriceForEachQuantity: A price for each quantity range. Example: up to 100 units, R$ 2.00 each; from 101 to 500, R$ 1.50 each.
produtos.theRangeAppliesToThe: The range applies to the whole order: all 150 units go at R$ 1.50, not only the ones above 100.
produtos.withNoRangesTheProduct: With no ranges, the product's sale price applies.
produtos.itIsHowTheQuote: It is how the quote counts how many sheets this product uses. It checks how many pieces fit on the paper sheet, with the bleed, and adds the make-ready sheets.
produtos.theMarginThePieceGets: the margin the piece gets on each side so the cut does not leave a white edge.
produtos.theOnesThePressUses: the ones the press uses to adjust color and position, on each job.
produtos.thePaperComesFromThe: The paper comes from the product variant. Leave the field empty to use the department value.
produtos.selectOnlyTheOnThis: Select only the {valor} on this page
produtos.productsOnThisPageAre: products on this page are selected.
produtos.selectAllProductsOnThis: Select all products on this page
produtos.yourSearchFoundNoResults: Your search found no results. Try again or add a new product
produtos.sizeMaterialAndServiceHourly: Size, material and service. Hourly service too.
produtos.paperStockBleedAndMake: Paper stock, bleed and make-ready sheets, as in quick printing.
produtos.sheetPrintedWithPrintRun: Sheet-printed, with print run, colors and plates.
produtos.boughtReadyMadeFromA: Bought ready-made from a supplier and resold.
produtos.theOutsourcedSupplierAndCost: The outsourced supplier and cost are kept. If the product becomes outsourced again, they come back.
produtos.theBleedTheMakeReady: The bleed, the make-ready sheets and the variants' paper stock are kept. If the product becomes sheet-printed again, they come back.
produtos.saysHowTheProductIs: Says how the product is made and sold. The form opens only the fields of that structure: sheet-printed asks for paper stock, bleed and make-ready sheets; outsourced asks for supplier and cost.
produtos.itIsNotTheProduct: It is not the product type or the department. Most visual communication products are Standard.
produtos.youCanChangeItLater: You can change it later. What the previous structure had is kept and comes back if it returns.
produtos.theSameProductInDifferent: The same product in different versions, such as sizes S, M and L or colors 4x0, 4x1 and 4x4.
produtos.eachVariantCanHaveIts: Each variant can have its own price and quantity prices. A variant without a price uses the product value.
produtos.inTheQuoteTheSalesperson2: In the quote, the salesperson picks the variant when adding the item.
produtos.saveTheProductToSet2: Save the product to set quantity-based prices for this variant.
produtos.thereWasAnErrorTrying: There was an error trying to {valor} the group. Please try again.
produtos.yourSearchReturnedNoResults: Your search returned no results. Try again or add a new product group
produtos.youDonTHavePermission2: You don't have permission to view product groups.
produtos.eachRowIsMatchedAgainst: Each row is matched against what's already in the system. Anything you link by hand is remembered, so next time the system already knows.
produtos.mMPcKgL: (m², m, pc, kg, l), department and cost per unit. The first row can be the header. Add the material in the unit your company sells it in: that's the unit the stock intake is converted to.
produtos.anExistingMaterialGetsThe: An existing material gets the cost from the spreadsheet (when it has no variant). A link to a different name is saved as a mapping.
produtos.confirmationToDeactivateOrReactivate: Confirmation to deactivate or reactivate the material.
produtos.itShowsUpAgainTo: It shows up again to pick in build-ups and sales. The build-ups it was removed from won't get it back on their own.
produtos.itIsnTInAny: It isn't in any build-up. It will no longer show up to pick in build-ups and sales.
produtos.andWillBeRemovedFrom: and will be removed from all of them. Where it was the only option on a line, the line is removed from the step. Quotes already made don't change.
produtos.toDeactivateAMaterialTurn: To deactivate a material, turn off the Active switch when editing it
produtos.whenAMaterialHasVariants: · when a material has variants, cost and price live in them, and a sale requires choosing the variant
produtos.addTheSupplyUsedIn: Add the supply used in the product build-up.
produtos.whenOnTheMaterialShows: When on, the material shows in the quote search and can be sold on its own, as resale (a board, a roll of vinyl).
produtos.whenOnTheMaterialCan: When on, the material can be chosen in product and process build-ups, and counts in their cost.
produtos.theMaterialFormatBoardRoll: The material format (board, roll, sheet, profile), dimensions and weight.
produtos.buildUpFormulasBoardOr: Build-up formulas, board or sheet yield and the cutting plan use this information. Without it, the material is charged by quantity only.
produtos.enterThemAsInThe: Enter them as in the supplier catalog: in a 50 × 30 profile, X is 50 and Y is 30.
produtos.whichOfTheTwoSides: Which of the two sides goes into the calculation is chosen in the build-up formula.
produtos.whenOnTheQuoteCharges: When on, the quote charges the whole sheet or board, even if the job uses only part of it.
produtos.whenOffItChargesOnly2: When off, it charges only the part used, as is common with ACM, where the leftover goes back to stock.
produtos.eachProductStepCanChange: Each product step can change this choice.
produtos.typeTheBrandsAndColors: Type the brands and colors separated by commas. The system creates a variant for each brand and color combination, all with the same cost.
produtos.exampleBrands3mOracalAnd: Example: brands 3M, Oracal and colors white, black create four variants.
produtos.withVariantsTheQuoteAsks: With variants, the quote asks you to choose one of them.
produtos.combinationsWillBeCreatedBrands: {combinations} combinations will be created ({valor} brands × {valor2} colors).
produtos.costAndPriceOfEach: Cost and price of each combination are set at the R$ in the list.
produtos.brandAndColorAreAdded: Brand and color are added after saving, as variants, when editing the material. Different thicknesses and sizes are different materials.
produtos.costAndSellingPriceOf: Cost and selling price of each material variant.
produtos.eachVariantSCostIs: Each variant's cost is changed directly in the table.
produtos.theSalePriceComesFrom: The sale price comes from Pricing: use the R$ on each row.
produtos.toAddBrandsAndColors: To add brands and colors, edit the material.
produtos.youDonTHavePermission3: You don't have permission to view materials.
produtos.materialsMakeUpTheProducts: Materials make up the products the company already sells, with no need to re-register them.
produtos.youDonTHavePermission4: You don't have permission to view product settings.
produtos.theBuildUpRowsAre: The build-up rows are already saved. Only what was changed in the Process card hasn't been saved yet.
produtos.checkTheUsageForA: Check the usage for a given size. Nothing is saved.
produtos.appliesTheStepRulesTo: Applies the step rules to the simulation: follow the base quantity, use its size and how many pieces fit in it.
produtos.theSameFieldsAsThe2: The same fields as the process record. What the step uses is in the Build-up.
produtos.whatToAskTheCustomer: What to ask the customer, what to check before closing
produtos.theValuesTheSalespersonEnters: The values the salesperson enters and that this process's rows read. A product that includes the process gets these fields, once each.
produtos.setupIsAppliedOncePer: Setup is applied once per order, at the department's hourly cost.
produtos.changesMadeHereAreSaved: Changes made here are saved with the Save button in the footer.
produtos.aDepartmentSStepThe: A department's step: the machine, material and labor it uses, each with its own calculation type. A product that includes the process follows this setup.
produtos.quantityCostAndSaleOf: Quantity, cost and sale of the lines calculated at
produtos.sizeSourceFromThePrevious: Size source: from the previous step
produtos.thisProcessHasNoResources: This process has no resources yet. Add below the machine, material and labor the {valor} department uses, each with its own calculation type.
produtos.whenNoReadyMadeCalculation: When no ready-made calculation type fits, write the formula: it reads the sizes, the quantity and the quote fields of this process, and will show up in the rows' calculation types. A product that includes the process gets the formula along with it.
produtos.changingTheProcessChangesThe: Changing the process changes the products
produtos.productsFollowThisProcessChanging: Products follow this process: changing the setup here changes all of them. Anything a product adjusted just for itself stays as it is, and quotes already made don't change.
produtos.noProductUsesThisProcess: No product uses this process yet.
produtos.theseAreSuggestionsNotA: These are suggestions, not a required order. When building a product, "+ next step" shows what is checked here first; the rest stays under "see all". Checking one side shows on the other. With nothing checked, the finishes of the same department apply.
produtos.theProcessCardHasnT: The Process card hasn't been saved yet. The rows are already saved.
produtos.youDonTHavePermission5: You don't have permission to view processes.
produtos.confirmationToDeactivateOrReactivate2: Confirmation to deactivate or reactivate the process.
produtos.itShowsUpAgainTo2: It shows up again to pick in build-ups and in quotes. Steps that use it lose the inactive process flag.
produtos.noProductUsesThisProcess2: No product uses this process. It will no longer show up to pick in build-ups and in quotes.
produtos.theStepStaysInThe: . The step stays in the products, flagged "inactive process"; the process just stops being offered in new build-ups and in quotes. Quotes already made don't change.
produtos.notUsedInAnyProduct: Not used in any product yet.
produtos.productsFollowThisProcessChanging2: Products follow this process: changing the build-up changes all of them. What each product adjusted only for itself stays as it is, and quotes already made do not change.
produtos.whenStartingAProductThe: When starting a product, the process always asks for its own size and quantity. Resources, time and sales rules go in the Build-up tab, after saving; the steps that usually come before and after, in the Steps tab.
produtos.resourcesAndTimeComeAfter: Resources and time come after saving
produtos.fillInTheProcessTab: Fill in the Process tab and save. The process reopens on this tab so you can build the rows: machine, material, labor and time.
produtos.hereAreTheStepsThat: Here are the steps that usually come before and after this process, as a suggestion when building the product.
produtos.aProcessIsADepartment: A process is a department step that repeats across several products: printing, hem, grommets.
produtos.theProductFollowsTheProcess: · the product follows the process and can adjust it just for itself
produtos.eachProcessIsAProduction: Each process is a production step in a department, with machine, material, labor and outsourced work.

vendas.theCallOnWhatsappButton: The "Call on WhatsApp" button and the follow-up email use these texts.

vendas.inBracesWhatTheSystem: In braces, what the system fills in: {valor}.

vendas.youDoNotHavePermission: You do not have permission to view this setting.
vendas.loggingContactsSchedulingTheNext: Logging contacts, scheduling the next contact and remembering who to follow up are part of the sales follow-up.
vendas.manageSalespeopleTheirCommissionsAnd: Manage salespeople, their commissions and permissions.
vendas.manageTheSourcesYourCustomers: Manage the sources your customers come from.
vendas.setTheMarkupOnCost: Set the markup on cost for outsourced work added on the spot.
vendas.skipTheQuoteSetupAnd: Skip the quote setup and go straight to picking the item.
vendas.setReasonsToTrackRejections: Set reasons to track rejections and cancellations.
vendas.whatsappMessageTemplatesEMail: WhatsApp message templates, e-mail reminder and customers without purchases.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view rejection and cancellation reasons.
vendas.customizeTheReasonsForRejecting: Customize the reasons for rejecting quotes and canceling work orders.
vendas.thisSourceWillNoLonger: This source will no longer appear in your company's options. You can restore it from settings.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission2: You don't have permission to view lead sources.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission3: You don't have permission to view sales settings.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission4: You don't have permission to view salesperson roles.
vendas.billOnOrderWhenThe: Bill on order (when the sale is approved)
vendas.billAtTheCashRegister: Bill at the cash register (the cashier collects)
vendas.chargeAtSaleTheSeller: Charge at sale (the seller collects upfront)

vendas.theQuoteNumberMustBe: The quote number must be zero or greater
vendas.proposalValidityCanBeAt: Proposal validity can be at most 999 days
vendas.deliveryTimeCanBeAt: Delivery time can be at most 999 days
vendas.eraseAllQuotesWorkOrders: Erase all quotes, work orders and transactions.
vendas.allDataFromTheSales: All data from the sales series was erased
vendas.allQuotesWorkOrdersAnd: All quotes, work orders and financial transactions will be erased.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission5: You don't have permission to view sales series.
vendas.tagsToTrackTheNegotiation: Tags to track the negotiation: where each quote stands while the customer decides (proposal sent, negotiating).
vendas.theQuoteListFiltersBy: The quote list filters by them. The quote's progress (draft, waiting, approved) is different and comes from the system.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission6: You don't have permission to view quote statuses.
vendas.inTheQuotationTheSeller: In the quotation, the seller enters the supplier cost and the system suggests the sale price: cost + this percentage. The percentage shows next to the price and the seller can change the value on the spot. Outsourced work gets no overhead allocation: the price is just the cost plus the markup.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission7: You don't have permission to configure one-off outsourced work.
vendas.addOutsourcedWorkInsideThe: Add outsourced work inside the quote item.
vendas.whenOnQuickSaleShows: When on, quick sale shows in the Sales menu.
vendas.theSalespersonSkipsTheQuote: The salesperson skips the quote form and goes straight to picking the item. It is for small counter sales: a copy, a couple of prints.
vendas.whatTheSystemFillsIn: What the system fills in on its own
vendas.theseAreTheFieldsOf: These are the fields of the new quote dialog. Set once here, they're no longer asked on every sale.
vendas.everyQuickSaleStartsWith: Every quick sale starts with this customer. It is usually the company itself or a generic customer such as "Consumer": create it once in Records and pick it here.
vendas.ifTheSaleNeedsAn: If the sale needs an invoice or installments, the salesperson changes the customer in the sale itself.
vendas.leaveEmptyToLetThe: Leave empty to let the items describe the sale
vendas.alwaysTheUserCurrentlyUsing: Always the user currently using the system
vendas.aQuickSaleIsA: A quick sale is a regular quote marked as quick: it follows the same path through approval, work order and finance.
vendas.appliesToTheSaleSent: Applies to the sale sent to the cash register, when the customer pays now and picks up later. Where the sale is received is defined by the sales series, in Settings › Sales › Sales series.
vendas.whenTheCustomerLeavesThe: When the customer leaves the job to pick up later, the register only releases it once the minimum deposit is paid. The rest is collected on pickup. Anyone with permission can waive the deposit case by case.
vendas.youDonTHavePermission8: You don't have permission to configure quick sale.
vendas.counterSalesWithNoCustomer: Counter sales, with no customer record and no questions asked.
